title: With the option on, the export adds the closed rows at 0.00
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed today, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours and one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2, Shop supplies $15.00.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced today, billable.
custom_steps:
1. Open Export Reports.
  2. Pick Customer Invoice.
  3. Tick "Include internal and no-charge work orders".
  4. Export today's file.
  5. Open the file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window opens.

Step 2:

  • The option shows.

Step 3:

  • The option is ticked.

Step 4:

  • A file is exported.

Step 5:

  • The file has the columns Classification and Category.
  • Work order 2's rows read Classification Billable with Category empty.
  • Work order 1 has one row per line, Classification Internal, Category General Internal, ItemRate and ItemAmount 0.00 on every row.
  • Work order 1 has no tax amount and no Supplies row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R6: “The Customer Invoice export in the Export Reports dialog gets the option "Include internal and no-charge work orders" (off by default; shown under the rule of S9-R4) with the helper "For your records only. Do not import these rows as invoices." While the option is off the file is exactly today's file. With the option on, the file adds the columns Classification (Billable, Internal, No Charge) and Category (empty on billable rows) and the rows of the closed internal and no-charge work orders of the range: one row per labor and part line as for an invoice, ItemRate and ItemAmount 0.00 on every line, no tax amount and no Supplies row. Parts cost and shop supplies of these work orders are in the Internal Work Orders report (S9-R2), not in this export.”
  • S9-R11: “With Show all on Technician Efficiency, internal and no-charge work orders count as work orders with their hours and no sales. In the export, internal and no-charge rows carry 0.00 on every line, their Classification and their Category (S9-R6); a no-charge line of a billable work order carries 0.00 on its own row with its Category. Every report, the export and the asset Invoices tab date a closed record by its posting date and a no-charge line by its invoice date.”
